<parameter=code>
seg = current_frame.segmentation
green_items = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'N']

    r = sum(p[0] for p in boundary) // len(boundary)
    c = sum(p[1] for p in boundary) // len(boundary)
    positions.append((r, c))
print(f"Green positions: {positions}")

# Find all purple items
purple_items = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'p']
print(f"Purple count: {len(purple_items)}")

    boundary = n['boundary']
    r = sum(p[0] for p in boundary) // len(boundary)
    c = sum(p[1] for p in boundary) // len(boundary)
    print(f"  Purple at ({r}, {c})")

blue_items = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'b']
if blue_items:
    blue_r = sum(p[0] for p in blue_items[0]['boundary']) // len(blue_items[0]['boundary'])
    blue_c = sum(p[1] for p in blue_items[0]['boundary']) // len(blue_items[0]['boundary'])
    print(f"Blue at: ({blue_r}, {blue_c})")

# Try clicking bottom purple item to reposition character
# From image, bottom purple items at ~row 55
# Try clicking one
if purple_items:
    # Click the leftmost purple item
    purple_positions = []
    for n in purple_items:
        boundary = n['boundary']
        r = sum(p[0] for p in boundary) // len(boundary)
        c = sum(p[1] for p in boundary) // len(boundary)
        purple_positions.append((r, c))
    purple_positions.sort(key=lambda x: x[1])
    print(f"Purple positions sorted: {purple_positions}")
    
    # Click leftmost purple
    r, c = purple_positions[0]
    result = action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': r, 'col': c}])
    print(f"After clicking purple ({r},{c}): state={last_action_result.get('state')}")
    
    # Check character position
    seg = current_frame.segmentation
    blue_items = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'b']
    if blue_items:
        blue_c = sum(p[1] for p in blue_items[0]['boundary']) // len(blue_items[0]['boundary'])
        print(f"Blue col after purple click: {blue_c}")
    
    # Try moving left
    for i in range(10):
        result = action(['LEFT'])
        seg = current_frame.segmentation
        blue_items = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'b']
        if blue_items:
            blue_c = sum(p[1] for p in blue_items[0]['boundary']) // len(blue_items[0]['boundary'])
            if i < 2 or i == 9:
                print(f"After LEFT {i+1}: blue col={blue_c}")
    
    # Now try collecting remaining green items
    seg = current_frame.segmentation
    green_items = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'N']
    print(f"Green count: {len(green_items)}")
    for n in green_items:
        boundary = n['boundary']
        r = sum(p[0] for p in boundary) // len(boundary)
        c = sum(p[1] for p in boundary) // len(boundary)
        result = action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': r, 'col': c}])
        state = last_action_result.get('state')
        seg = current_frame.segmentation
        green_count = sum(1 for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'N')
        print(f"Clicked ({r}, {c}): green={green_count}, state={state}")
        if state == 'GAME_OVER':
            print("Game over!")
            break
        if last_action_result.get('level_completed') or last_action_result.get('done'):
            print("Level completed!")
            break
